items.title: OCC Issues Supervisory Framework on Bank Use of Super Intelligence
items.source: U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
items.excerpt: The OCC issued its first supervisory framework (Bulletin 2026-54) for bank examiners on banks' use of AI and agentic AI (branded 'Super Intelligence'); examiners are told not to treat it as a separate risk category and banks need no separate risk appetite.
items.rationale: Primary agency release: first US bank-examiner framework for AI/agentic AI, a concrete rule change for anyone building AI for banks.

items.title: France, US clash over G7 effort on AI safety
items.excerpt: France's proposal for G7-level oversight of AI safety met White House opposition, which called it 'unnecessary bureaucracy', exposing a split ahead of further G7 AI talks.
items.rationale: Fresh geopolitics/policy news: a named French G7 AI-safety oversight proposal and the White House's attributed rejection; whitelisted outlet.

items.title: CERT-In sets six-hour reporting deadline for AI security incidents
items.excerpt: India's CERT-In issued AI security audit guidelines with a four-tier risk framework and a mandatory six-hour reporting window for AI-related cybersecurity incidents, building on its 2022 directions.
items.rationale: New binding regulator guideline (four-tier risk + 6-hour incident reporting) that directly changes compliance for AI deployers in India.

items.title: Delhi High Court protects actor Kriti Sanon against AI deepfakes, impersonation
items.excerpt: The Delhi High Court ordered takedown of URLs carrying AI deepfakes of the actor and directed authorities to issue blocking orders against sites hosting pornographic deepfakes; the court said personality rights are not a single cause of action.
items.rationale: Court ruling on AI deepfakes and personality rights with takedown and blocking orders — a concrete legal decision, not commentary.

items.title: IPOPHL readies measure protecting artists vs AI use
items.excerpt: The Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines opened public consultation on a draft copyright guideline governing AI use of artists' works.
items.rationale: Official draft copyright guideline on AI use of creative works opened for consultation — a new regulatory filing from an IP office.
